== Published English Original Virtual Set 2 wording ==
The early slip permits selection of a qualifying character to be lost with the weapon. The July 2007 dated replacement deploys and moves like an Undercover spy and puts both cards into an all-cards loss. A separately archived Players Committee full face retains the opponent-side deployment and ordinary control-phase movement, and calls for both cards to be lost directly. The archive confirms when the image was captured. Its first publication and dating relative to the July errata remain unknown.
